reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and threads holidays through every existing weekend site, but the daily-skip sites build their own holiday test instead of reusing the isOff predicate the helper now has.

duplication.why: The `isWeekend(date) || holidaySet.has(dayFromDate(date))` day-off test plus its Set construction is written four times: inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate's isWeekday, and both daily paths in schedules/app.ts.

placement.why: The moving logic sits in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend helper lives and the field is added to RecurConfig and parseRecurDate; only the per-site holiday filters belong in that shared module too.

scope.why: Every edit serves the holidays field; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: The direction-walk is clean, but the definition of a non-working day lives in four copies, so the next change to it (e.g. a different off-day source) must be repeated.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All moving sites go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no existing day-off predicate was available to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate isWeekday, schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates .filter lambda and getDatesInRange `continue` condition: each re-expresses the isOff predicate of getDateWithSkippedWeekend in a different shape

one_place.where: The day-off rule is defined in getDateWithSkippedWeekend's local isOff for moves, but separately re-stated for daily skips in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and in schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange
